description: This file defines the TimeBasedBuffer class, a data structure that maintains the last X seconds worth of numerical values, each associated with a millisecond timestamp. It provides methods for adding values, retrieving the current set of values, and maintaining a fixed duration window.

classes.name: TimeBasedBuffer
classes.description: A class implementing a time-sensitive buffer holding one value per millisecond within a specified duration.

methods.name: TimeBasedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with a specific duration.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Removes entries older than the specified duration.

methods.name: currentTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the current system time in milliseconds.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new value with the current timestamp.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of stored values after truncating old entries.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves an array of current values in the buffer.
